Chapter 1183: Chapter 6 Fierce Sun and Xuanyin (Seeking Subscription)

"Greetings, Great Saint of the Galaxy."

The Wild Barbarian Great Saint, Black Light Great Saint, and several other Chaos Great Saints quickly met with Lin Yuan.

At this moment, Lin Yuan was facing away from them, busy adjusting the numerous rules of the Great Dao on the Chaos Continent.

The Chaos Continent had been first opened, and although time and space had stabilized, many other rules of the Great Dao still needed adjustment.

Only in this way could this Chaos Continent be more perfect and free from hidden dangers.

"Great Saint of the Galaxy..." The Wild Barbarian Great Saint, Black Light Great Saint, and other Chaos Great Saints saw that Lin Yuan did not respond. They dared not continue inquiring, so they stood obediently in place.

The occasional grand fluctuations of rules emanating from the Chaos Continent below left several Chaos Great Saints in awe.

"The Great Saint of the Galaxy’s understanding of the rules... is terrifying," several Chaos Great Saints thought to themselves, feeling the impact of Lin Yuan on the Chaos Continent below at such a close distance.

"Even if our true bodies were here and we used all our trump cards, we wouldn’t last long against the Great Saint of the Galaxy."

Black Light Great Saint thought to himself, clearly aware of the power gap between the current Great Saint of the Galaxy and the one in the Xuanhuang Universe.

"You have arrived."

Lin Yuan glanced at Black Light Great Saint, Wild Barbarian Great Saint, and casually said, "Have you brought the Chaos Stones?"

"We have brought them," Black Light Great Saint replied with a slight respect, treating Lin Yuan as a peerless Great Saint, and then brought out a world bracelet.

"We have also brought them."

The Wild Barbarian Great Saint, Tian Lu Great Saint, and other Chaos Great Saints, seeing this, quickly brought out the Chaos Stones they had prepared.

"In that case."

Lin Yuan counted and then released the main combat bodies of the several Chaos Great Saints.

Of course, the weapons and numerous treasures on these main combat bodies were all taken by Lin Yuan.

The Wild Barbarian Great Saint, Black Light Great Saint, and other Great Saints had expected this. They only redeemed their main combat bodies, with no thoughts of reclaiming their weapons and treasures.

"Then, Great Saint of the Galaxy, we will take our leave."

Black Light Great Saint cautiously said.

Having retrieved his main combat body, Black Light Great Saint felt relieved. Although he knew someone as mighty as Lin Yuan would disdain breaking a promise, it still eased his mind.

"Hmm."

Lin Yuan nodded, and suddenly spoke to the several Chaos Great Saints, "I have established this Chaos Continent; are you interested in having your forces settle here?"

Both Black Light Great Saint and the Wild Barbarian Great Saint, as well as Tian Lu Great Saint and the other two newly appointed Great Saints, likely had a force behind them.

Unlike Lin Yuan’s sudden rise, other Chaos Great Saints had their paths of growth. Over long years, even if they didn’t intend to build forces, a faction would naturally form as their strength grew.

"Great Saint of the Galaxy... doesn’t mind our previous actions?"

Black Light Great Saint asked cautiously, delighted at heart.

Being able to settle on the Chaos Continent, near enough to rival a peerless Great Saint like Lin Yuan, was naturally an immense opportunity.

However, they thought there was resentment between them and Lin Yuan and dared not directly request this.

"Now that you’ve brought the Chaos Stones, there is no issue."

Lin Yuan said; the grievances between him and the Black Light Great Saint and other Chaos Great Saints were not irreconcilable. Since the Chaos Stones had been delivered, Lin Yuan chose not to pursue it further.

The newly established Chaos Continent needed various forces to settle to develop swiftly.

"Very well."

"I will go back and prepare."

The Black Light Great Saint and other Chaos Great Saints felt reassured and retreated at once.

....

"Two billion three hundred million Chaos Stones."

After the few Chaos Great Saints left, Lin Yuan glanced again at his gains.

"Next, I shall continue cultivating, aiming to quickly enter the Chaos Realm."

Lin Yuan thought to himself and began his seclusion again.

As for the myriad affairs on the Chaos Continent? Lin Yuan only needed to divert a fraction of his mind to maintain the overall situation, leaving miscellaneous matters to three goddesses.

...

Source World, Fierce Sun Ancient Country, Hei Yu Nest.

The Lin Yuan Taiyin Primordial Spirit sat cross-legged, using the exotic Hei Yu to refine his own mental will.

As a first-class treasure land of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, the Hei Yu produced by the Hei Yu Nest was highly beneficial to enhancing one’s mental will.

"My current mental will index is probably close to ninety million points."

Lin Yuan felt joyful, as the guardian of the Hei Yu Nest. If he wished, he could easily engage in personal gain. Lin Yuan wouldn’t go that far, but he certainly wouldn’t lack Hei Yu.

"In eight thousand years, the Hei Yu produced by the Hei Yu Nest will enter its maturity. Before then, I must be wary of the Xuanyin Ancient Country."

Lin Yuan gazed distantly towards the Xuanyin Ancient Country.

The Hei Yu Nest was situated on the border between the Fierce Sun Ancient Country and the Xuanyin Ancient Country. Though currently controlled by the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, each maturity period attracted strong figures from the Xuanyin Ancient Country.

The strong figures from the Xuanyin Ancient Country didn’t aim to completely seize the Hei Yu Nest.

But as long as they attacked the Hei Yu Nest during the maturity period and plundered some of its Hei Yu, they would profit greatly.

"The information given to me by Chi Yang Heavenly Venerate mentioned that the Xuanyin Ancient Country is always restless around the maturity period." Lin Yuan thought quietly.

Refining and enhancing mental will with exotic treasures?

Not only did the strong figures of Fierce Sun Ancient Country have a need, but those from Xuanyin Ancient Country also craved them intensely.

The six Ancient Countries rule over vast territories, and among the many mystical treasures that affect the spirit and will, Hei Yu is definitely among the best.

"This is also quite normal. Without the threat from the Xuanyin Ancient Country, why would there be a need for strong figures to guard the Hei Yu Nest?"

Lin Yuan pondered in his heart; the Fierce Sun Ancient Country treated every strong figure guarding important treasures well. Not only were they bestowed with merits from the Ancient Country, but they were also able to take a tenth of the resources produced from the treasure land.

"I must be cautious too."

"Otherwise, if the strong figures of the Xuanyin Ancient Country break in and seize part of the Hei Yu, I will surely face punishment, and even the emperor won’t be able to protect me."

Lin Yuan divided part of his focus to keep a watchful eye on the changes in the Hei Yu Nest and its surrounding areas.

...

Outside the Hei Yu Nest.

The time and space in a certain area slightly distorted.

Two figures stood silently there, looking at the Hei Yu Nest in the distance.

"By calculating the time, Hei Yu is about to mature."

The figure on the far left said softly.

"It is about to mature," said the figure on the right. "What is it? Jihan, do you have designs on Hei Yu?"

"For such a rare treasure as Hei Yu, don’t you have any thoughts?" Jihan Venerate glanced at the figure on the right. "I remember that your spirit and will, Beiyin, have always been a shortcoming at the Heavenly Venerable level. If you obtain enough Hei Yu, you can completely compensate for it."

The impact of spirit and will on strength is far less direct than that of the physical body and soul, but if there’s a gap in spirit and will, it’s a troublesome matter.

"I do have thoughts." Beiyin Venerable Sage shook his head and said, "But what good are thoughts? We can only watch. Occasionally, the Fierce Sun Country over there manages to sell some Hei Yu to us, but it’s hardly possible to snatch any."

Trade does exist between Ancient Countries, but when it involves resources and treasures of Hei Yu’s level, they are immediately seized by the royal family and powerful Heavenly Venerates of the Xuanyin Ancient Country as soon as they appear.

"Some time ago, the Hei Yu Nest changed its guardian; Chi Yang was transferred." Beiyin Venerable Sage spoke up.

"I know about this too," Jihan Venerate nodded. "The new guardian of the Hei Yu Nest is called Galaxy, and he is a core royal member. Tsk, the core royals are indeed different."

"Galaxy... It is said that he has made significant strides on the path to breaking through the bottleneck of the Heavenly Venerate, but no matter what, he has not stepped into the Heavenly Venerable Realm."

Beiyin Venerable Sage said.

"What do you mean?" Jihan Venerate asked, his expression thoughtful.

"If Chi Yang were here, I would have no designs on Hei Yu Nest. Chi Yang’s strength is formidable, and he controls many formations in the Hei Yu Nest without any opportunity for us."

"But this Galaxy..."

Beiyin Venerable Sage stopped speaking.

The implication was clear.

This core royal member, having grown to his limit, finds it difficult to achieve the comprehensive control that Chi Yang Heavenly Venerate had while guarding the Hei Yu Nest.

And this is precisely an opportunity for the two Heavenly Venerates.

"What do you plan to do?"

Jihan Venerate immediately asked.

He also realized this was an opportunity.

If they succeed, they would not lack Hei Yu for a long time to come.

As for failure... there would be no real loss.

"Over the years, during Chi Yang’s tenure as guard of the Hei Yu Nest, I conducted many probes and gained some understanding of the defensive formations within."

"Even if Galaxy has gained control over all formations since first taking charge of the Hei Yu Nest, he probably won’t be able to operate them seamlessly in the short term."

"We just need to sneak in during the gap between the formation’s operations....."

Beiyin Venerable Sage quickly said, having been planning this since Chi Yang was transferred and Galaxy Great Lord took over the Hei Yu Nest.

"Sneak in..." Jihan Venerate hesitated a bit.

If that Galaxy Great Lord reacts, seals them in, and corners them, wouldn’t the two Heavenly Venerates be in trouble?

"Don’t worry, that Galaxy is not Chi Yang; even if we are discovered, we can simply withdraw."

Beiyin Venerable Sage immediately reassured.

"Indeed."

Jihan Venerate thought for a moment and nodded.

Those core royals do not grasp the laws of heaven and earth as comprehensively as the Celestial Clan, and the same goes for their control of formations.

"But we must be careful not to expose our true identities."

Beiyin Venerable Sage reminded.

Among the Ancient Countries, unless it was in a large-scale, full-fledged battlefield, Heavenly Venerates would avoid clashing with one another whenever possible.

Since Beiyin Venerable Sage and Jihan Venerate decided to act, they would certainly hide their true identities, so that even if the Fierce Sun Ancient Country pursued the matter afterwards, they could argue that it was the action of Heavenly Venerates from other Ancient Countries.

As long as their identities were not exposed, the Xuanyin Ancient Country would protect them.

"Understood."

Jihan Venerate nodded.

This kind of thing was done behind the Xuanyin Ancient Country’s back, and it had to be kept secret; they could not confess afterwards, either.

...

Outside the Hei Yu Nest.

Beiyin Venerable Sage and Jihan Venerate, these two Heavenly Venerates from the Xuanyin Ancient Country, carefully observed the operation of the large formation at the Hei Yu Nest in the distance.

"Now."

Beiyin Venerable Sage’s eyes shimmered, and following the gap in the formation’s operation, he merged into the Hei Yu Nest, as did Jihan Venerate, both slipping inside one after the other.
